title: Masami Yūki Draws 2nd New Patlabor 1-Shot Manga
content: This year's combined 36th and 37th issue of Shogakukan 's Weekly Big Comic Spirits magazine announced on Monday that Masami Yūki will publish a second new one-shot story for the Patlabor franchise in the magazine's next issue on August 17.
author: ANN

title: Light Novel 'Tenkou-saki no Seiso Karen na Bishoujo ga, Mukashi Danshi to Omotte Issho ni Asonda Osananajimi Datta Ken' Ends with 11th Volume
content: Yu Hibari 's Tenkou-saki no Seiso Karen na Bishoujo ga, Mukashi Danshi to Omotte Issho ni Asonda Osananajimi Datta Ken ( Oh Boy, Was I Wrong About Her ) light novel ended with its 11th volume on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

content: My Hero Academia has officially returned with one final special for the anime, and its new timeskip finale short has confirmed that there’s a new number one hero now firmly in place heading into the future.

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Confirms Major Event for the U.S. Ahead of Season 3

title: Dragon Ball Super Reboot Raises Major Release Schedule Questions With New Update
content: Dragon Ball Super is ready for its return later this year with a brand new reboot anime series taking on the Battle of Gods arc , and a new schedule update has sparked some major questions about its release schedule.

title: 30 Years Later, Legendary Sci-Fi Anime Is Getting New Streaming Launch With Classic English Dub
content: A legendary science fiction anime is going to get a new streaming home soon, and it’s finally going to be launching with its missing English dub after all this time. Neon Genesis Evangelion is arguably one of the most influential science-fiction anime of all time.

title: One of The Greatest Comedy Anime of All Time Is Losing a Major Platform in August
content: As the anime industry continues to grow in popularity across the globe, major streaming platforms are also contributing to making popular shows easily accessible for fans. Crunchyroll is still the largest streaming hub for anime across various regions.

title: Kaguya Sama: Love Is War Creator’s Dark Fantasy Gets Cancelled After Hitaus
content: Following the controversial ending of Oshi no Ko , author Aka Akasaka returned with yet another bold and unique series titled Märchen Crown . The manga began serializing in Shueisha’s Weekly Young Jump magazine in March last year.
